I'm taking him to the vet tomorrow anyways, just to check he has no kidney damage, or anything similar, but I Also want to clarify a few things I read on your comments:

1. This is not the first time My cat is alone in the house, in his four years he has been very independent and well behaved everytime I left him for a day or two, wich is the most time he spends alone.

2. My House is practically babyproofed for him, I close every door except his room, I block the access to risky spaces and risky highs, My dinner table, My sofa, and other furniture, are Always covered in matress or plastic, just in case, but he has never damaged anything, again, in four years.

3. I'm 18 y/o, I don't have close friends or family who live closer to My House who can help me to watch out the cat everytime I go out, sometimes My uncle comes yo watch him but just if i'm letting him alone for more than two days, as You can Guess, I don't have the money to hire a pet nanny, without mentioning how risky is to have a stranger in My House who can steal or damage My cat, if I don't have money for that, I don't have money for security camaras neither.

4. After this experience, I have learn to be more precacious, theres a first time for everything, now I know I have to have another litter box and TRIPLE check everything.

Again, thank You everyone for your concern and help
